answer_1.quote: The generation approach forces Scalable-DSC to firstly generate a sequence of erroneous states and then continue generating a sequence of corrected states. ... Scalable-DSC corrects the prediction results of the DST model ... generating a corrected dialogue state natural language sequence.
answer_1.outputs: Corrected dialogue state sequences expressed as natural language text

answer_2.quote: The model is automatically evaluated based on two metrics . Joint Goal Accuracy is the primary evaluation metric for cross-domain DST tasks. ... Slot Accuracy only considers individual slot-level accuracy, calculating the proportion of the correct slot values filled in the slot from a macro perspective.
